## What landed
- One commit: `internal/adapter/adapter.go` defines `adapter.Adapter`
  (Name, DefaultRoot, Discover, Find, Load, Current) and `adapter.Default()`,
  the only place that selects Claude Code. `claudecode.Adapter` (empty struct)
  implements it by delegating to the existing package functions, which stay
  exported. `cmd/turncost/main.go` now has no `claudecode.` reference; `loadAll`
  takes the adapter. `sessions` and `turns` behave as before.
- `claudecode.Current(root, dir)` returns the *path* of the newest `*.jsonl`
  (by mtime) in `root/<EncodeDir(abs dir)>`; error when none. `claudecode.EncodeDir`
  is exported for reuse. Test: encoded `.`/`/` path, two transcripts with
  different mtimes, a newer transcript in another project and a non-jsonl file
  that must be ignored, plus the no-transcript error.
- DESIGN.md Adapters section updated (interface, encoding, Current caveat).

## Landmark drift
None.

## Deviations from the work order
- `Current` returns a transcript path, not a session id (the plan only gave the
  signature). Callers get the id from `Load(path).ID` or the file name.

## What the next session must know
- `internal/adapter` imports `claudecode` (for `Default`); `claudecode` does not
  import `adapter`, the interface is satisfied structurally. Keep it that way
  to avoid an import cycle.
- Encoding is per rune (non-ASCII-alnum → `-`). For non-BMP characters Claude
  Code (JS) may emit two dashes; unverified, not covered by the plan.
- Handover store (a later unit) needs the same encoding but must be
  harness-neutral: it should take the encoded name via the adapter (or call
  `claudecode.EncodeDir` from the CLI layer), not import claudecode itself.
- `Current` does `filepath.Abs(dir)` and does not resolve symlinks.

## Open problems
None. `just verify` and `just test` green; tree clean.
